items.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake in Panama
items.where: Herrera, Los Santos and Veraguas, Panama
items.summary: The strongest quake to hit Panama this century damaged hundreds of homes, schools, roads and bridges, followed by more than 200 aftershocks. One death and 27 injuries were reported; the UN counted about 3,700 people in shelters.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab hits India’s east coast
items.summary: Arnab made landfall near Yanam as a very severe cyclonic storm with winds of 125–135 km/h. More than 180,000 people were evacuated; reported deaths range from three to seven as counts continued.

items.title: Severe storms in southern Brazil
items.where: Santa Catarina and southern states, Brazil
items.summary: Heavy rain, strong winds and hail hit southern Brazil between 5 and 7 November. Santa Catarina recorded 671 storm-related incidents across 76 municipalities in two days.

items.title: Flash floods across Cambodia
items.summary: Flash floods from heavy rain affected nearly 45,000 families across Cambodia, and more than 3,600 families had to move to higher ground.

items.title: Flooding in Gaza’s displacement camps
items.summary: Winter rains flooded tent camps where most of Gaza’s population lives; Denmark pledged $8.9 million in aid to help with the flooding and the wider humanitarian situation.
